title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode10 I Just Want to be Myself

meta.Episode: Episode10 — I Just Want to be Myself

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mornin'♪ How's everybody doing?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, Mizuki! Long time no see! But it's not morning. Class is already over. What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was told to come take supplementary lessons because of my grades. It really stinks.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Haha. You're really good at studying though, so I'm sure you'll finish in no time. Well, have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! What a pain...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Just keep these two theorems in mind, and remember which one to apply based on what you're trying to find over here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, now I get it. I just sort of got the answer without thinking, but that makes sense♪)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Is that the student you were talking about? This is my first time seeing them.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
I've never seen them in person before either.
If you didn't mention them I wouldn't have noticed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Do they think they're whispering?
Because I can totally hear everything they're saying.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Whatever. It's not like this is the first time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Finally finished!
I wonder if I should stop somewhere on the way home♪

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student A's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, that 1st year student was here today. Did you see?

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student B's Voice
rows.Line: You mean the one you were talking about before? No! I wish I had!

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student A's Voice
rows.Line:
You should. I'm telling you, you really can't tell.
Super cute, too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Great. I really don't want to deal with this.
But it'd be a pain to have to sit here until they leave, too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
I'm not on exhibition here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Mizuki? You finished with your class?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We just finished with club activities. Want to head home together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, sure. Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student A
rows.Line: Hey, speak of the devil! You're Akiyama, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, that would be me.
Is there something I can do for you?

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student B
rows.Line: Oh, not really. I was just a little curious about why you dress the way you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? I figured that would be obvious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I dress this way because I like to.
That's all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, see you around♪

rows.Speaker: 2nd Year Student A
rows.Line: Hey, wait!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Some people can be so rude, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm used to it.
People like that are always saying things about stuff that doesn't concern them.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: If anything like that happens again, let us know. The least we can do is listen.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Well, we're this way. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright! Time to go do a little shopping to relax!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, this place might have that eyeliner I couldn't find last time. I can check out what else they have, too.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What do you think of this blush?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I like it. It doesn't have too much glitter either, so you could probably use it at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh? They're both here shopping?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you guys—

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You know, if Mizuki doesn't like people pointing it out, then why not just dress normally for school?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Of course people are going to say things when you stand out like that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's just the way Mizuki is, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Totally. Some people just don't know how to fit in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... So that's how it is?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If that's what they really thought, then why bother talking to me as if they understood?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's so stupid...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All I want to do is be myself.
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well...maybe she's right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yuki? You okay?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, yeah. I'm fine. That kind of stuff doesn't really bother me, I guess.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Liar.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yuki, it actually bothers you too, doesn't it?
